name: Rocco Arena
note: THE KEY RECORD. Age 39 in March 1900 and indexed year of birth 1861 -- which CONFIRMS the family tree's birth year for Rocco Arena, and does so from a source entirely independent of it. Recorded as a US CITIZEN, so he had naturalised: he was in America years before this, and his son Antonio was born at New York in 1895. THE 1900 IMAGE HAS NOW BEEN READ: line 27 of the S.S. Trave, 'Arena Rocco', 39, married, SAILOR -- matching the marinaro of act 22 of 1893 -- nationality 'Citizen U.S.A.', last residence SCILLA, carrying $50. NOTE FOR ANYONE REPEATING THIS: the 1900 form has NO parental columns, so it cannot name his father. That question needs a different record.

name: Anna Arena
note: THE IMAGE NAMES HER RELATIONSHIP. Line 4 of the manifest does not begin with her surname but with the word 'NIECE' -- 'Niece, Anna Arena', 6, occupation 'none'. She is the niece of the Giovanni Arena on the line above, who is himself going to join 'brother Rocco'. The document therefore states, twice over, that Giovanni is Rocco's brother and Anna is Rocco's daughter. The tree puts her crossing in 1894 aged one; it was 23 May 1899, aged six, and she was brought over by her uncle.

name: Giovanni Arena
note: THE IMAGE HAS NOW BEEN READ AND IT NAMES THE RELATIONSHIPS OUTRIGHT. Line 3: Arena Giovanni, 45, SAILOR, going to join -- in the column for whether the passenger joins a relative -- 'BROTHER ROCCO, N. YORK, MULBERRY ST'. So GIOVANNI ARENA IS ROCCO ARENA'S BROTHER, a sibling the family tree does not have, and Rocco was living on MULBERRY STREET, New York, in May 1899. His age of 45 matches the Arena Giovanni born at Scilla on 20 April 1854 exactly -- though that act names the mother Rosa Arlotta where Rocco's is Serafina Arlotta, which is the one loose end.

name: Michele Donato
note: THE IMAGE HAS NOW BEEN READ. S.S. LIGURIA, sailing from PALERMO on 22 FEBRUARY 1908. Line 15, no. 130: DONATO MICHELE, aged 52, male, married, SAILOR, Italian, South Calabria, last permanent residence SCILLA. Nearest relative in the country whence he came: 'WIFE MARIA SOFI, VIA GROTTE, SCILLA' -- confirming his wife AND the street from act 162 of 1892 (Via Grotte 31), from a document filled in on another continent sixteen years later. Final destination: QUINCY, FLORIDA. His age of 52 is the THIRD independent witness to a birth about 1856 against the tree's 1851.

name: Giuseppe Polistena
note: Candidate for the tree's Giuseppi Polistena b. 1875, Giovanni Polistena's elder brother. Two years out on the age, which is ordinary.

name: Maria Polistena
note: On the line immediately after Giuseppe -- a married couple travelling together.

name: Giovanni Donato
note: LINE 2 -- immediately after Annunziata Polistena. A Polistena and a Donato teenager side by side on one manifest in 1903, nine years before Giovanni Polistena married Nunziata Donato. The families were already travelling together.

name: Pasquale Donato
note: Same ship, same frame as Lorenjo Costa two lines below.

name: Lorenjo Costa
note: Two lines below Pasquale Donato. Costa is Generosa Costa's surname; Donato is Michele's.

name: Domenica Anile
note: EXACT. The tree gives her birth as 20 February 1880, which makes her twenty-six on 2 August 1906. She is line 27 of a family group occupying five consecutive lines.

name: Fillipo Melluso
note: Indexed as 'FOLOPPO MELLUSO ANILE' -- the transcriber ran the child's surname into his mother's. He is three years old and on the line immediately after Domenica Anile, whose son he is by Domenico Melluso. The tree has him born 1903 and arriving 2 August 1906: both correct.

name: Concetta Anile
note: The tree gives her birth as 1888, which would make her eighteen. The manifest says twenty-one. She is the only Concetta Anile on the voyage and the tree already claimed this exact arrival date and the port of Naples, so it is her with the age overstated -- which was routine for a young woman travelling without her parents.

name: Teresa Anile
note: Line 25, at the head of the group. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Francesco Anile
note: One year old, line 29, closing the group. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE under this name -- most likely another child of Domenica Anile, indexed under her maiden surname as her son Filippo nearly was.

name: Filippo Melluso
note: A SECOND Filippo Melluso of Briatico on the same ship, aged thirteen, four lines and two frames earlier. Not the tree's man, who is the three-year-old. Recorded so that nobody later merges them.

name: Giovanni Polistena
note: ON THE LINE IMMEDIATELY AFTER MICHELE DONATO. Aged 24, single, SAILOR, of Scilla -- which fits his birth on 16 September 1883 exactly. Nearest relative: 'FATHER ANTONINO POLISTENA AND MOTHER GIOVANNA ROMANO, SCILLA'. THAT SETTLES THE OLDEST CONFLICT IN THIS ARCHIVE: the family tree calls his mother Giovanna PONTILLO; act 206 of 1883 says Giovanna ROMANO; and now a US immigration manifest, taken from his own statement twenty-five years later and half a world away, says GIOVANNA ROMANO. Destination: QUINCY, FLORIDA. The tree records no crossing for him at all. He would marry Michele Donato's daughter Nunziata about eight years after they sailed together.
